verses.ar: وَوُلِدَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَخْتُونًا بِيَدِ الْعِنَايَةِ
verses.tr: Wa wulida ṣallā-Llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama makhtūnan bi-yadil-ʿināyah
verses.en: He ﷺ was born already circumcised by the hand of divine care.

verses.ar: مَكْحُولاً بِكُحْلِ الْهِدَايَةِ
verses.tr: Makḥūlan bi-kuḥlil-hidāyah
verses.en: his eyes anointed with the kohl of guidance.

verses.ar: فَأَشْرَقَ بِبَهَائِهِ الْفَضَاءْ
verses.tr: Fa-ashraqa bi-bahāʾihil-faḍāʾ
verses.en: By his radiance all space lit up,

verses.ar: وَتَلألأَ الْكَوْنُ مِنْ نُورِهِ وَأَضَاءْ
verses.tr: Wa talaʾlaʾal-kawnu min nūrihi wa aḍāʾ
verses.en: and the universe sparkled and shone with his light.

verses.ar: وَدَخَلَ فِيْ عَهدِ بَيعَتِهِ مَنْ بَقِيَ مِنَ الْخَلائِقِ كَمَا دَخَلَ فِيهَا مَنْ مَضَىْ
verses.tr: Wa dakhala fī ʿahdi bayʿatihi man baqiya minal-khalāʾiqi kamā dakhala fīhā man maḍā
verses.en: Into the covenant of allegiance to him entered all creatures yet to come, just as those who had gone before had entered it.

verses.ar: أَوَّلُ فَضِيلَةٍ مِنَ الْمُعجِزَاتِ بِخُمُودِ نَارِ فَارِسَ وَسُقُوطِ الشُّرُفَاتِ، وَرُمِيَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ بِالشُّهُبِ الْمُحرِقَاتْ، وَرَجَعَ كُلُّ جَبَّارٍ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَهُوَ بِصَولَةٍ سَلطَنَتِهِ ذَلِيلٌ خَاضِعٌ
verses.tr: Awwalu faḍīlatin minal-muʿjizāti bi-khumūdi nāri Fārisa wa suqūṭish-shurufāt, wa rumiyatish-shayāṭīnu minas-samāʾi bish-shuhubil-muḥriqāt, wa rajaʿa kullu jabbārin minal-jinni wa huwa bi-ṣawlati salṭanatihi dhalīlun khāḍiʿ
verses.en: Among the first of his miracles was the dying out of the fire of Persia and the collapse of its palace balconies; the devils were pelted from the sky with burning stars; and every tyrant among the jinn returned, brought low and humbled despite the force of his dominion.

verses.ar: لَمَّا تَأَلَّقَ مِن سَنَاهُ النُّورُ السَّاطِعُ وَأَشرقَ مِن بَهَائِهِ الضِّياءُ اللّاَّمِعُ حَتَى عُرِضَ عَلٰى الْمَرَاضِعْ
verses.tr: Lammā taʾallaqa min sanāhun-nūrus-sāṭiʿu wa ashraqa min bahāʾihiḍ-ḍiyāʾul-lāmiʿu ḥattā ʿuriḍa ʿalal-marāḍiʿ
verses.en: When the blazing light flashed from his brilliance and the gleaming radiance shone from his splendour, he was then presented to the wet-nurses.

verses.ar: قِيلَ مَن يَكْفُلُ هٰذِهِ الدُّرَّةَ الْيَتِيمَةَ التِّي لا تُوجَدُ لَهَا قِيمَةٌ؟ قَالَتِ الطُّيُورُ نَحْنُ نَكْفُلُهُ وَنَغْتَنِمُ هِمَّتَهُ الْعَظِيمَةْ
verses.tr: Qīla man yakfulu hādhihid-durratal-yatīmatal-latī lā tūjadu lahā qīmah? qālatiṭ-ṭuyūru naḥnu nakfuluhu wa naghtanimu himmatahul-ʿaẓīmah
verses.en: It was asked: Who will take charge of this priceless orphan pearl? The birds said: We will care for him and seize the honour of his mighty aspiration.

verses.ar: قَالَتِ الْوُحُوشُ نَحْنُ أَولَىْ بِذٰلِكَ لِكَيْ نَنَالَ شَرَفَهُ وَتَعظِيمَهْ
verses.tr: Qālatil-wuḥūshu naḥnu awlā bi-dhālik likay nanāla sharafahu wa taʿẓīmah
verses.en: The wild beasts said: We are more deserving of that, so that we may attain his honour and his glorification.

verses.ar: قِيلَ يَا مَعشَرَ الْأُمَمِ اسْكُنُوا فَإِنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ فِيْ سَابِقِ حِكمَتِهِ الْقَدِيمَةْ، بِأَنَّ نَبِيَّهُ مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَكُونُ رَضِيعًا لِحَلِيمَةَ الْحَلِيمَةْ
verses.tr: Qīla yā maʿsharal-umamiskunū fa-inna-Llāha qad ḥakama fī sābiqi ḥikmatihil-qadīmah, bi-anna nabiyyahu Muḥammadan ﷺ yakūnu raḍīʿan li-Ḥalīmatal-ḥalīmah
verses.en: It was said: O company of nations, be still, for Allah has decreed in His prior, ancient wisdom that His Prophet Muhammad ﷺ will be nursed by the gentle Halima.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا أَعرَضَ عَنهُ مَرَاضِعُ الْإِنسِ لِمَا سَبَقَ فِيْ طَيِّ الْغَيبِ مِنَ السَّعَادَةِ لِحَلِيمَةَ بِنتِ أَبِيْ ذُؤَيبْ
verses.tr: Falammā aʿraḍa ʿanhu marāḍiʿul-insi limā sabaqa fī ṭayyil-ghaybi minas-saʿādati li-Ḥalīmata binti Abī Dhuʾayb
verses.en: When the human wet-nurses turned away from him — because of the happiness already ordained in the folds of the unseen for Halima bint Abi Dhuʾayb —

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا وَقَعَ نَظَرُهَا عَلَيهِ، بَادَرَتْ مُسْرِعَةً إِلَيهِ، وَوَضَعَتْهُ فِيْ حِجْرِهَا، وَضَمَّتْهُ إِلَى صَدْرِهَا
verses.tr: Falammā waqaʿa naẓaruhā ʿalayhi, bādarat musriʿatan ilayhi, wa waḍaʿat-hu fī ḥijrihā, wa ḍammat-hu ilā ṣadrihā
verses.en: the moment her glance fell upon him, she hurried to him, placed him in her lap, and pressed him to her chest.

verses.ar: فَهَشَّ لَهَا مُتَبَسِّمًا فَخَرَجَ مِن ثَغْرِهِ نُورٌ لَحِقَ بِالسَّمَاءِ، فَحَمَلَتْهُ إِلَى رَحلِهَا، وَارتَحَلَتْ بِهِ إِلَى أَهلِهَا
verses.tr: Fa-hashsha lahā mutabassiman fa-kharaja min thaghrihi nūrun laḥiqa bis-samāʾ, fa-ḥamalat-hu ilā raḥlihā, wartaḥalat bihi ilā ahlihā
verses.en: He beamed at her with a smile, and from his mouth came forth a light that reached the sky. She carried him to her mount and set off with him to her people.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا وَصَلَتْ بِهِ إِلَى مُقَامِهَا، عَايَنَتْ بَرَكَتَهُ حَتَّىْ عَلٰى أَغنَامِهَا
verses.tr: Falammā waṣalat bihi ilā muqāmihā, ʿāyanat barakatahu ḥattā ʿalā aghnāmihā
verses.en: When she reached her dwelling with him, she witnessed his blessing even upon her flocks.

verses.ar: وَكَانَتْ كُلَّ يَومٍ تَرَى مِنهُ بُرهَانًا، وَتَرفَعُ لَهُ قَدرًا وَشَأنًا
verses.tr: Wa kānat kulla yawmin tarā minhu burhānan, wa tarfaʿu lahu qadran wa shaʾnā
verses.en: Every day she saw from him a fresh proof, and his worth and standing rose ever higher in her eyes.

verses.ar: حَتَّىْ انْدَرَجَ فِيْ حُلَّةِ اللُّطفِ وَالأَمَانْ، وَدَخَلَ بَيْنَ إِخوَتِهِ مَعَ الْصِبْيَانْ
verses.tr: Ḥattandaraja fī ḥullatil-luṭfi wal-amān, wa dakhala bayna ikhwatihi maʿaṣ-ṣibyān
verses.en: until he grew up wrapped in the garment of gentleness and safety, and mixed among his foster-siblings and the other children.

verses.ar: فَبَينَمَا الْحَبِيبُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ذَاتَ يَومٍ نَاءٍ عَنِ الْأَوطَانِ، إِذْ أَقبَلَ عَلَيهِ ثَلاثَةُ نَفَرٍ، كَأَنَّ وُجُوهَهُمُ الشَّمسُ وَالقَمَر
verses.tr: Fa-baynamal-ḥabību ﷺ dhāta yawmin nāʾin ʿanil-awṭān, idh aqbala ʿalayhi thalāthatu nafarin, ka-anna wujūhahumush-shamsu wal-qamar
verses.en: One day, while the Beloved ﷺ was some distance from home, three persons approached him, their faces as though the sun and the moon.

verses.ar: فَانْطَلَقَ الصِّبْيَانُ هَرَبًا، وَوَقَفَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُتَعَجِّبًا
verses.tr: Fanṭalaqaṣ-ṣibyānu haraban, wa waqafan-nabiyyu ﷺ mutaʿajjibā
verses.en: The other children ran off in fright, while the Prophet ﷺ stood in wonder.

verses.ar: فَأَضْجَعُوهُ عَلٰى الْأَرضِ إِضْجَاعًا خَفِيفًا، وَشَقُّوا بَطنَهُ شَقًّا لَطِيفًا
verses.tr: Fa-aḍjaʿūhu ʿalal-arḍi iḍjāʿan khafīfan, wa shaqqū baṭnahu shaqqan laṭīfā
verses.en: They laid him gently upon the ground and opened his chest with a delicate incision.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَخرَجُوا قَلبَ سَيِّدِ وَلَدِ عَدنَانَ، وشَرَحُوهْ بِسِكِّينِ الْإِحسَانِ، وَنَزَعُوا مِنهُ حَظَّ الشَّيطَانِ، وَمَلأُوهُ بِالحِلمِ وَالعِلمِ وَاليَقِينِ وَالرِضوَان
verses.tr: Thumma akhrajū qalba sayyidi waladi ʿAdnāna, wa sharaḥūhu bi-sikkīnil-iḥsāni, wa nazaʿū minhu ḥaẓẓash-shayṭāni, wa malaʾūhu bil-ḥilmi wal-ʿilmi wal-yaqīni war-riḍwān
verses.en: Then they brought out the heart of the master of the children of ʿAdnan, opened it with the knife of excellence, removed from it the portion of Satan, and filled it with forbearance, knowledge, certainty, and [Allah's] good pleasure.

verses.ar: وَأَعَادُوهُ إِلى مَكَانِهِ فَقَامَ الْحَبِيبُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ سَوِيًّا كَمَا كَانَ
verses.tr: Wa aʿādūhu ilā makānihi fa-qāmal-ḥabību ﷺ sawiyyan kamā kān
verses.en: They returned it to its place, and the Beloved ﷺ rose up whole, just as he had been.

verses.ar: يَا حَبِيبَ الرَّحمٰنِ لَو عَلِمتَ مَا يُرَادُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخَيرِ لَعَرَفتَ قَدرَ مَنزِلَتِكَ عَلٰى الْغَيرِ، وَازْدَدتَ فَرَحًا وَسُرُورًا وَبَهجَةً وَنُورًا
verses.tr: Yā ḥabībar-Raḥmāni law ʿalimta mā yurādu bika minal-khayri la-ʿarafta qadra manzilatika ʿalal-ghayr, wazdadta faraḥan wa surūran wa bahjatan wa nūrā
verses.en: [The angels said:] O beloved of the All-Merciful, had you known the good that is intended for you, you would recognise your rank above all others, and you would only increase in joy, delight, gladness, and light.

verses.ar: يَا مُحَمَّدُ أَبشِرْ، فَقَدْ نُشِرَتْ فِيْ الْكَائِنَاتِ أَعلامُ عُلومِك، وَتَبَاشَرَتِ الْمَخلُوقَاتُ بِقُدُومِكَ، وَلَمْ يَبقَىْ شَيءٌ مِمَّا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى إِلَّا جَاءَ لِأَمرِكَ طَائِعًا، وَلِمَقَالَتِكَ سَامِعًا
verses.tr: Yā Muḥammadu abshir, faqad nushirat fil-kāʾināti aʿlāmu ʿulūmik, wa tabāsharatil-makhlūqātu bi-qudūmik, wa lam yabqa shayʾun mimmā khalaqa-Llāhu taʿālā illā jāʾa li-amrika ṭāʾiʿan, wa li-maqālatika sāmiʿā
verses.en: O Muhammad, rejoice! The banners of your knowledge have been unfurled across the worlds, creation has exulted at your coming, and nothing Allah Most High created remains but that it comes obedient to your command and attentive to your word.

verses.ar: فَسَيَأتِيكَ الْبَعِيرُ بِذِمَامِكَ يَستَجِيرُ، وَالضَّبُّ وَالغَزَالَةُ، يَشهَدانِ لَكَ بِالرِّسَالَةْ
verses.tr: Fa-sa-yaʾtīkal-baʿīru bi-dhimāmika yastajīr, waḍ-ḍabbu wal-ghazālah, yash-hadāni laka bir-risālah
verses.en: The camel will come seeking your protection; the lizard and the gazelle will both bear witness to your prophethood.

verses.ar: وَالشَّجَرُ وَالقَمَرُ والذِئبُ يَنطِقُونَ بِنُبُوَّتِكَ عَن قَرِيبٍ
verses.tr: Wash-shajaru wal-qamaru wadh-dhiʾbu yanṭiqūna bi-nubuwwatika ʿan qarīb
verses.en: The trees, the moon, and the wolf will soon speak openly of your prophethood.

verses.ar: وَمَركَبُكَ الْبُراقُ إِلى جَمَالِكَ مُشتَاقٌ
verses.tr: Wa markabukal-burāqu ilā jamālika mushtāq
verses.en: Your mount, al-Buraq, longs for your beauty.

verses.ar: وَجِبرِيلُ شَاوُوشُ مَملَكَتِكَ قَدْ أَعلَنَ بِذِكرِكَ فِي الْآفَاقِ
verses.tr: Wa Jibrīlu shāwūshu mamlakatika qad aʿlana bi-dhikrika fil-āfāq
verses.en: And Jibril, the herald of your kingdom, has already proclaimed your remembrance across the horizons.

verses.ar: وَالقَمَرُ مَأمُورٌ لَكَ بِالانشِقَاقْ
verses.tr: Wal-qamaru maʾmūrun laka bil-inshiqāq
verses.en: And the moon has been commanded to split for you.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لِبَعضِهِمْ: كَأَنَّ وَجهَهُ الْقَمَرْ، فَقَالَ: بَلْ أَضْوَأُ مِنَ الْقَمَرِ، إِذَا لَمْ يَحُلْ دُونَهُ الْغَمَامُ، قَدْ غَشِيَهُ الْجَلالُ وَانْتَهَىْ إلْيهِ الْكَمَالُ
verses.tr: Wa qīla li-baʿḍihim: ka-anna wajhahul-qamar, fa-qāla: bal aḍwaʾu minal-qamari, idhā lam yaḥul dūnahul-ghamām, qad ghashiyahul-jalālu wantahā ilayhil-kamāl
verses.en: It was said to some of them: His face was like the moon. He replied: Rather brighter than the moon when no cloud veils it — majesty enveloped him, and perfection reached its fullness in him.

verses.ar: وَبَينَمَا الْحَبِيبُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ مُنصِتٌ لِسَمَاعِ تِلكَ الْأَشبَاحِ، وَوَجهُهُ مُتَهَلِّلٌ كَنُورِ الصَّبَاحِ
verses.tr: Wa baynamal-ḥabību ﷺ munṣitun li-samāʿi tilkal-ashbāḥ, wa wajhuhu mutahallilun ka-nūriṣ-ṣabāḥ
verses.en: And while the Beloved ﷺ was quietly listening to those forms, his face beaming like the light of morning,

verses.ar: إِذْ أَقبَلَتْ حَلِيمَةُ مُعلِنَةً بِالصِّيَاحِ تَقُولُ: وَاغَرِيبَاهُ. فَقَالَتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ: مَا أَنتَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ بِغَرِيبٍ، بَلْ أَنْتَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ قَرِيبٌ، وَأَنتَ لَهُ صَفِيٌّ وَحَبِيبٌ
verses.tr: Idh aqbalat Ḥalīmatu muʿlinatan biṣ-ṣiyāḥi taqūlu: wā gharībāh. Fa-qālatil-malāʾikatu: mā anta yā Muḥammadu bi-gharīb, bal anta mina-Llāhi qarīb, wa anta lahu ṣafiyyun wa ḥabīb
verses.en: Halima came crying out: 'O my poor lonely one!' The angels said: 'You are no stranger, O Muhammad; rather you are near to Allah, His chosen one and His beloved.'

verses.ar: قَالَتْ حَلِيمَةُ: وَاوَحِيدَاهُ. فَقَالَتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ: يَا مُحَمَّدُ، مَا أَنتَ بِوَحِيد، بَلْ أَنتَ صَاحِبُ التَّأيِيدِ، وَأَنِيسُكَ الْحَمِيدُ الْمَجِيدُ، وَإِخوَانُكَ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَأَهلُ التَّوحِيدِ
verses.tr: Qālat Ḥalīmatu: wā waḥīdāh. Fa-qālatil-malāʾikatu: yā Muḥammadu, mā anta bi-waḥīd, bal anta ṣāḥibut-taʾyīd, wa anīsukal-ḥamīdul-majīd, wa ikhwānukal-malāʾikatu wa ahlut-tawḥīd
verses.en: Halima said: 'O my lonely one!' The angels said: 'O Muhammad, you are not alone; you are the one granted divine support; your companion is the Praiseworthy, the Glorious; and your brethren are the angels and the people of divine oneness.'

verses.ar: قَالَتْ حَلِيمَةُ: وَايَتِيمَاهُ. فَقَالَتِ الْمَلائِكَةُ: لِلّٰهِ دَرُّكَ مِن يَتِيمٍ، فَإِنَّ قَدرَكَ عِندَ اللّٰهِ عَظِيم
verses.tr: Qālat Ḥalīmatu: wā yatīmāh. Fa-qālatil-malāʾikatu: lillāhi darruka min yatīmin, fa-inna qadraka ʿinda-Llāhi ʿaẓīm
verses.en: Halima said: 'O my orphan!' The angels said: 'How excellent an orphan you are! For your rank with Allah is tremendous.'

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَلِيمَةُ سَالِمًا مِنَ الْأَهوَالِ رَجَعَتْ بِهِ مَسرُورَةً إِلَى الْأَطلالِ، ثُمَّ قَصَّتْ خَبَرَهُ عَلٰى بَعضِ الْكُهَّانْ
verses.tr: Falammā raʾat-hu Ḥalīmatu sāliman minal-ahwāli rajaʿat bihi masrūratan ilal-aṭlāl, thumma qaṣṣat khabarahu ʿalā baʿḍil-kuhhān
verses.en: When Halima saw him safe from all terrors, she returned with him joyfully to her camp, then related his story to some of the soothsayers.

verses.ar: وَأَعَادَتْ عَلَيهِ مَا تَمَّ مِنْ أَمرِهِ وَمَا كَانَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ الْكَاهِنُ: يَا ابْنَ زَمزَمَ وَالْمَقَامِ وَالرُّكنِ وَالبَيتِ الْحَرَامِ، أَفِيْ الْيَقْظَةِ رَأَيْتَ هٰذَا أَمْ فِيْ الْمَنَامِ؟
verses.tr: Wa aʿādat ʿalayhi mā tamma min amrihi wa mā kān, fa-qāla lahul-kāhinu: yā-bna Zamzama wal-Maqāmi war-Rukni wal-Baytil-ḥarām, a-fil-yaqẓati raʾayta hādhā am fil-manām?
verses.en: She recounted to him all that had happened, and the soothsayer said to him: 'O son of Zamzam, the Station, the Corner, and the Sacred House — did you see this while awake or in a dream?'

verses.ar: فَقَالَ وَحُرْمَةِ الْمَلِكِ الْعَلَّامِ، شَاهَدتُهُمْ كِفَاحًا لا أَشُكُّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ وَلا أُضَامُ
verses.tr: Fa-qāla wa ḥurmatil-malikil-ʿallām, shāhadtuhum kifāḥan lā ashukku fī dhālika wa lā uḍām
verses.en: He said: 'By the sanctity of the All-Knowing King, I saw them face to face; I have no doubt of it, nor am I deceived.'

verses.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُ الْكَاهِنُ: أَبشِرْ أَيُّهَا الْغُلامُ، فَأَنتَ صَاحِبُ الْأَعلامِ، وَنُبُوَّتُكَ لِلأَنبِيَاءِ قِفلٌ وَخِتَامٌ، وَعَلَيكَ يَنزِلُ جِبرِيلُ، وَعَلى بِسَاطِ الْقُدسِ يُخَاطِبُكَ الْجَلِيلُ
verses.tr: Fa-qāla lahul-kāhinu: abshir ayyuhal-ghulām, fa-anta ṣāḥibul-aʿlām, wa nubuwwatuka lil-anbiyāʾi qiflun wa khitām, wa ʿalayka yanzilu Jibrīl, wa ʿalā bisāṭil-qudsi yukhāṭibukal-jalīl
verses.en: The soothsayer said: 'Rejoice, O boy! You are the bearer of the banners; your prophethood is the lock and seal upon all prophethood; upon you Jibril will descend, and upon the carpet of holiness the Majestic One will address you.'

verses.ar: وَمَنْ ذَا الذِّيْ يَحصُرُ مَا حَوَيتَ مِنَ التَّفضِيلِ، وَعَنْ بَعضِ وَصفِ مَعنَاكَ يَقصُرُ لِسَانُ الْمَادِحِ الْمُطِيلِ
verses.tr: Wa man dhal-ladhī yaḥṣuru mā ḥawayta minat-tafḍīl, wa ʿan baʿḍi waṣfi maʿnāka yaqṣuru lisānul-mādiḥil-muṭīl
verses.en: Who could ever encompass the excellences you contain? Even the tongue of the most lavish praiser falls short of describing a fraction of your reality.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَحسَنَ النَّاسِ خَلقًا وَخُلُقًا، وَأَهْدَاهُمْ إِلَىْ الْحَقِّ طُرُقًا، وَكَانَ خُلُقُهُ الْقُرْآنَ
verses.tr: Wa kāna ﷺ aḥsanan-nāsi khalqan wa khuluqan, wa ahdāhum ilal-ḥaqqi ṭuruqan, wa kāna khuluquhul-Qurʾān
verses.en: He ﷺ was the finest of people in form and in character, the most rightly guiding of them to the truth — and his character was the Qur'an itself.

verses.ar: وَشِيمَتُهُ الْغُفرَانَ، يَنصَحُ لِلإِنسَانِ، وَيَفسَحُ فِيْ الْإِحسَانِ، وَيَعفُو عَنِ الذَّنبِ إِنْ كَانَ فِيْ حَقِّهِ وَسَبَبِهْ
verses.tr: Wa shīmatuhul-ghufrān, yanṣaḥu lil-insān, wa yafsaḥu fil-iḥsān, wa yaʿfū ʿanidh-dhanbi in kāna fī ḥaqqihi wa sababih
verses.en: Forgiveness was his nature; he gave sincere counsel to people, was expansive in doing good, and pardoned wrongs done against him.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ضُيِّعَ حَقُّ اللّٰهِ لَمْ يَقُمْ أَحَدٌ لِغَضَبِهِ، مَنْ رَآهُ بَدِيهَةً هَابَهُ، وَإِذَا دَعَاهُ الْمِسكِينُ أَجَابَهُ
verses.tr: Fa-idhā ḍuyyiʿa ḥaqqu-Llāhi lam yaqum aḥadun li-ghaḍabihi, man raʾāhu badīhatan hābahu, wa idhā daʿāhul-miskīnu ajābah
verses.en: But when a right of Allah was violated, none could stand before his anger. Whoever saw him unexpectedly was struck with awe of him, and when a poor person called upon him, he answered.

verses.ar: يَقُولُ الْحَقَّ وَلَوْ كَانَ مُرًّا، وَلاَ يُضْمِرُ لِمُسلِمٍ غِشًّا وَلا ضُرًّا
verses.tr: Yaqūlul-ḥaqqa wa law kāna murran, wa lā yuḍmiru li-muslimin ghishshan wa lā ḍurrā
verses.en: He spoke the truth even if it was bitter, and he harboured toward no Muslim any deceit or harm.

verses.ar: مَنْ نَظَرَ فِيْ وَجْهِهِ عَلِمَ أَنَّهُ لَيسَ بِوَجْهِ كَذَّابٍ، وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيسَ بِغَمَّازٍ وَلا عَيَّابٍ
verses.tr: Man naẓara fī wajhihi ʿalima annahu laysa bi-wajhi kadhdhāb, wa kāna ﷺ laysa bi-ghammāzin wa lā ʿayyāb
verses.en: Whoever looked into his face knew it was not the face of a liar; and he ﷺ was neither a backbiter nor a faultfinder.

verses.ar: إِذَا سُرَّ كَأَنَّ وَجهَهُ قِطعَةُ قَمَرٍ، وَإِذَا كَلَّمَ النَّاسَ، فَكَأَنَّمَا يَجنُونَ مِنْ كَلامِهِ أَحلَىْ ثَمَرٍ
verses.tr: Idhā surra ka-anna wajhahu qiṭʿatu qamar, wa idhā kallaman-nāsa, fa-ka-annamā yajnūna min kalāmihi aḥlā thamar
verses.en: When he was glad, his face was like a piece of the moon; and when he spoke to people, it was as though they were gathering the sweetest fruit from his words.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا تَبَسَّمَ تَبَسَّمَ عَنْ مِثلِ حَبِّ الْغَمَامِ، وَإِذَا تَكَلَّمَ فَكَأَنَّ الدُّرَّ يَسقُطُ مِن ذٰلِكَ الْكَلامِ، وَإِذَا تَحَدَّثَ فَكَأَنَّ الْمِسكَ يَخرُجُ مِن فِيهِ
verses.tr: Wa idhā tabassama tabassama ʿan mithli ḥabbil-ghamām, wa idhā takallama fa-ka-annad-durra yasquṭu min dhālikal-kalām, wa idhā taḥaddatha fa-ka-annal-miska yakhruju min fīh
verses.en: When he smiled, his teeth shone like hailstones of a cloud; when he spoke, it was as though pearls fell from his words; and when he conversed, it was as though musk issued from his mouth.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَرَّ بِطَرِيقٍ عُرِفَ مِنْ طِيبِهِ أَنَّهُ قَد مَرَّ فِيهِ
verses.tr: Wa idhā marra bi-ṭarīqin ʿurifa min ṭībihi annahu qad marra fīh
verses.en: When he passed along a road, it was known from his fragrance that he had passed there.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا جَلَسَ فِيْ مَجلِسٍ بَقِيَ طِيبُهُ فِيهِ أَيَّامًا وَإِنْ تَغَيَّبَ، وَيُوجَدُ مِنْهُ أَحسَنُ طِيبٍ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قَدْ تَطَيَّبَ
verses.tr: Wa idhā jalasa fī majlisin baqiya ṭībuhu fīhi ayyāman wa in taghayyab, wa yūjadu minhu aḥsanu ṭībin, wa in lam yakun qad taṭayyab
verses.en: When he sat in a gathering, his fragrance lingered there for days after he had left; and the finest scent came from him, though he had used no perfume.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَشَىْ بَينَ أَصحَابِهِ فَكَأَنَّهُ الْقَمَرُ بَينَ النُّجُومِ الزُّهَرِ
verses.tr: Wa idhā mashā bayna aṣḥābihi fa-ka-annahul-qamaru baynan-nujūmiz-zuhar
verses.en: When he walked among his companions, he was like the moon among the bright shining stars.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا أَقبَلَ لَيْلاً فَكَأَنَّ النَّاسَ مِنْ نُورِهِ فِيْ أَوَانِ الظُّهرِ
verses.tr: Wa idhā aqbala laylan fa-ka-annan-nāsa min nūrihi fī awāniẓ-ẓuhr
verses.en: When he approached by night, his light made people feel as though it were the hour of noon.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَجوَدَ بِالخَيرِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ الْمُرسَلَةِ، وَكَانَ يُرفَقُ بِاليَتِيمِ وَالأَرمَلَةِ
verses.tr: Wa kāna ﷺ ajwada bil-khayri minar-rīḥil-mursalati, wa kāna yarfuqu bil-yatīmi wal-armalah
verses.en: He ﷺ was more generous with good than the sent wind, and he was gentle with the orphan and the widow.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ بَعضُ وَاصِفِيهِ: مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ ذِيْ لُمَّةٍ سَودَاءَ فِيْ حُلَّةٍ حَمرَاءَ، أَحسَنَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللّٰهِ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ
verses.tr: Wa qāla baʿḍu wāṣifīhi: mā raʾaytu min dhī lummatin sawdāʾa fī ḥullatin ḥamrāʾa, aḥsana min rasūli-Llāhi ﷺ
verses.en: One who described him said: 'I never saw anyone with black locks in a red garment more beautiful than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.'

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لِبَعضِهِمْ: كَأَنَّ وَجهَهُ الْقَمَرْ، فَقَالَ: بَلْ أَضْوَأُ مِنَ الْقَمَرِ، إِذَا لَمْ يَحُلْ دُونَهُ الْغَمَامُ، قَدْ غَشِيَهُ الْجَلالُ وَانْتَهَىْ إِلَيهِ الْكَمَالُ
verses.tr: Wa qīla li-baʿḍihim: ka-anna wajhahul-qamar, fa-qāla: bal aḍwaʾu minal-qamari, idhā lam yaḥul dūnahul-ghamām, qad ghashiyahul-jalālu wantahā ilayhil-kamāl
verses.en: It was said to some of them: His face was like the moon. He replied: Rather brighter than the moon when no cloud veils it; majesty enveloped him, and perfection reached its fullness in him.

verses.ar: قَالَ بَعضُ وَاصِفِيهِ: مَا رَأَيْتُ قَبْلَهُ وَلاَ بَعدَهُ مِثلَهُ
verses.tr: Qāla baʿḍu wāṣifīhi: mā raʾaytu qablahu wa lā baʿdahu mithlah
verses.en: One who described him said: 'I never saw, before him or after him, anyone like him.'

verses.ar: فَيَعجَزُ لِسَانُ الْبَلِيغِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يُحصِيَ فَضلَهُ
verses.tr: Fa-yaʿjazu lisānul-balīghi idhā arāda an yuḥṣiya faḍlah
verses.en: The tongue of the most eloquent fails when it tries to enumerate his excellence.

verses.ar: فَسُبْحَانَ مَنْ خَصَّهُ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِالْمَحَلِّ الْأَسْنَىْ، وَأَسْرَىْ بِهِ إِلَى قَابِ قَوسَينِ أَوْ أَدْنَىْ
verses.tr: Fa-subḥāna man khaṣṣahu ﷺ bil-maḥallil-asnā, wa asrā bihi ilā qābi qawsayni aw adnā
verses.en: Glory be to the One who singled him ﷺ out with the loftiest station, and took him by night to the distance of two bows' length or nearer.

verses.ar: وَأَيَّدَهُ بِالْمُعْجِزَاتِ الَّتِيْ لاَ تُحْصَىْ
verses.tr: Wa ayyadahu bil-muʿjizātil-latī lā tuḥṣā
verses.en: And supported him with miracles beyond counting,

verses.ar: وَأَوْفَاهُ مِنْ خِصَالِ الْكَمَالِ مَا يَجِلُّ أَنْ يُستَقصَىْ، وَأَعْطَاهُ خَمْسَةً لَمْ يُعْطِهِنَّ أَحَدًا قَبلَهُ
verses.tr: Wa awfāhu min khiṣālil-kamāli mā yajillu an yustaqṣā, wa aʿṭāhu khamsatan lam yuʿṭihinna aḥadan qablah
verses.en: and granted him such perfect qualities as are too great to be fully counted, and gave him five things He had given to none before him.

verses.ar: وَآتَاهُ جَوَامِعَ الْكَلِمِ، فَلَمْ يُدرِكْ أَحَدٌ فَضْلَهُ
verses.tr: Wa ātāhu jawāmiʿal-kalim, fa-lam yudrik aḥadun faḍlah
verses.en: He gave him the most comprehensive of speech; no one has grasped the full measure of his merit.

verses.ar: وَكَانَ لَهُ فِيْ كُلِّ مَقَامٍ مَقَالٌ، وَلِكُلِّ كَمَالٍ مِنهُ كَمَالٌ
verses.tr: Wa kāna lahu fī kulli maqāmin maqāl, wa li-kulli kamālin minhu kamāl
verses.en: In every station he had the fitting word, and to every perfection he added a perfection of his own.

verses.ar: لاَ يَحُورُ فِيْ سُؤَالٍ وَلاَ جَوَابٍ، وَلاَ يَجُولُ لِسَانُهُ إِلْاَّ فِيْ صَوَابٍ
verses.tr: Lā yaḥūru fī suʾālin wa lā jawāb, wa lā yajūlu lisānuhu illā fī ṣawāb
verses.en: He was never at a loss in question or answer, and his tongue moved in nothing but what was correct.

verses.ar: وَمَا عَسَىْ أَنْ يُقَالَ فِيْ مَنْ وَصَفَهُ الْقُرْآنْ، وَأَعْرَبَ عَنْ فَضَائِلِهِ التَّورَاةُ وَالإِنجِيلُ وَالزَّبُورُ وَالفُرقَانْ
verses.tr: Wa mā ʿasā an yuqāla fī man waṣafahul-Qurʾān, wa aʿraba ʿan faḍāʾilihit-Tawrātu wal-Injīlu waz-Zabūru wal-Furqān
verses.en: And what more can be said of one whom the Qur'an described, and whose excellences the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the Criterion all made known?

verses.ar: وَجَمَعَ اللّٰهُ لَهُ بَينَ رُؤْيَتِهِ وَكَلامِهِ، وَقَرَنَ اسْمَهُ مَعَ اسْمِهِ تَنبِيهًا عَلٰى عُلُوِّ مَقَامِهِ
verses.tr: Wa jamaʿa-Llāhu lahu bayna ruʾyatihi wa kalāmihi, wa qarana-smahu maʿa-smihi tanbīhan ʿalā ʿuluwwi maqāmih
verses.en: Allah joined for him both the seeing of Him and the speaking with Him, and coupled his name with His own Name, as a sign of the loftiness of his station.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَهُ رَحمَةً لِلعَالَمِينَ وَنُورًا، وَمَلأَ بِمَولِدِهِ الْقُلُوبَ سُرُورًا
verses.tr: Wa jaʿalahu raḥmatan lil-ʿālamīna wa nūran, wa malaʾa bi-mawlidihil-qulūba surūrā
verses.en: He made him a mercy to all the worlds and a light, and filled hearts with joy through his birth.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهْ
verses.tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik ʿalayhi wa ʿalā ālih
verses.en: O Allah, bless him, grant him peace, and pour Your blessings upon him and his family.
